objective: Reduce the human cost of reviewing the 32-frame slope packet without converting assistant opinions into human truth or training data.
problem: A no-slope decision previously required a full-frame truth save, which forced reviewers to re-check unrelated classes. The packet also had no bounded assistant preview to focus attention on ambiguous slope geometry.

implementation.decision_binding: POST decisions must match the active packet, manifest SHA-256, source-frame SHA-256, current slope-geometry SHA-256, reviewer identity, review start time, idempotency key, and optionally the exact assistant proposal SHA-256.
implementation.dirty_geometry_behavior: If the browser draft geometry differs from the content-bound slope geometry, scoped sign-off is disabled and the reviewer must use the full truth gate.
implementation.decision_storage: Append-only per-packet decision chain under work/review_packets/<packet>/decisions.
implementation.truth_boundary: Scoped decisions do not call the full truth save endpoint and remain human_truth=false, approved_for_training=false, training_return_allowed=false.

assistant_review.interpretation: The suggestions are an assistant review aid derived from the already-bound packet views. They are not current human labels and cannot unlock training.

browser_acceptance.environment: Fresh isolated copy of formal state, file sessions, file library, packet manifest, and assistant review on port 8875.

publication_boundary: Factory images, assistant-review.json, browser result, screenshot, and the illustrated acceptance document remain local untracked artifacts. Source, tests, and this non-image structured record may be synchronized.
model_training_boundary: This round does not fine-tune or post-train SAM. No new model checkpoint exists. Human review is still required before any train/test split or model-accuracy claim.
remaining_gate: A human must explicitly review the 32 packet frames. Only then can confirmed samples be split into non-overlapping training and evaluation sets for a bounded fine-tuning experiment.
